title: Micronauts The New Voyages #20 Marvel 1986 Final Issue Bill Sienkiewicz Cover
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Micronauts: The New Voyages #20 (May 1986), Marvel Comics - final issue of the series. "Cosmic Conclusion! The Final Fate of the Micronauts!" - "To Meet the Maker!" Bill Sienkiewicz cover, Marvel 25th Anniversary corner box. 75c cover price.

Back cover: Scott Adams Questprobe Marvel Adventure computer game ad (Hulk).

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
